title: Lowercase a string
description: Write a function `to_lower(text)` that returns `text` with every character changed to lowercase.
hints: Every string has a .lower() method, the mirror image of .upper() - it returns a new string with every letter in lowercase.
Call .lower() on text and return the result directly.
explanation: str.lower() mirrors .upper() - both return a new string rather than modifying the original, since strings are immutable in Python.
